descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-12 step 6, ER 2-3; TFA-92590 AC 3 · “Three points entered on separate lines show as three separate cards in both modes”.

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S02 Nursing Home: the same flow, cards added on the tab survive the editor's Save Note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57). (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Same physician, one Nursing Home resident with no points

When Open the pre-round editor, type note A, leave the bottom points box empty, Save Note; check the Important Points panel on the tab; add three points with the panel's Add Point; reopen the editor, replace the note with note B without touching the bottom box, Save Note

Then Panel empty after the first save; three separate cards after adding; the same three cards, unchanged, after the re-save

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-12 steps 1-3 and 6, Expected bullets 1-3; TFA-92590 AC 2-3. Checkpoints, judged now: cp1 has no card and the empty state does not tell the physician the AI fills the panel (mustNotContain 'process notes with AI', judged under U1, known: TFA-92590; a plain Fail until oracleRules 5); cp2 and cp3 show the three texts. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
